page.overview:
Who is Becker?

Becker was a dark-skinned Human member of the Rebellion.

Becker was imprisoned at Balis-Baurgh prison where he met and befriended Junas Turner and Grael the Ewok. After Turner and Grael escaped the prison, they intended to mount a rescue mission to recover Becker and fellow Alliance prisoner Lon.
